name: Hyderabad
tagline: The City of Pearls: Nizam-era heritage and legendary biryani
description: Hyderabad blends Qutb Shahi and Nizam-era history with a modern tech city. It is famous for its forts, palaces, bazaars and Hyderabadi cuisine.

places.name: Charminar
places.desc: The 16th-century monument with four minarets, surrounded by the busy Laad Bazaar for bangles and pearls.

places.name: Golconda Fort
places.desc: A grand hill fort of the Qutb Shahi dynasty, known for its acoustics and evening sound-and-light show.

places.name: Hussain Sagar
places.desc: A large lake with a giant Buddha statue on an island. Good for a boat ride and an evening walk.

places.name: Chowmahalla Palace
places.desc: The palace of the Nizams, with beautiful courtyards, halls and a vintage car collection.

places.name: Salar Jung Museum
places.desc: One of India's largest one-man art collections, with sculptures, manuscripts and clocks from around the world.

places.name: Ramoji Film City
places.desc: A huge film studio complex with guided tours, sets, shows and rides. Plan a full day.

restaurants.name: Paradise Biryani
restaurants.known_for: Iconic Hyderabadi dum biryani.

restaurants.name: Bawarchi
restaurants.known_for: Popular biryani and kebabs.

restaurants.name: Pista House
restaurants.known_for: Famous for haleem, especially in Ramzan season.

restaurants.name: Nimrah Cafe & Bakery
restaurants.known_for: Irani chai with Osmania biscuits.

restaurants.name: Chutneys
restaurants.known_for: Idli, dosa and a wide range of chutneys.

name: Delhi
tagline: Mughal monuments, bustling markets and street food
description: India's capital mixes centuries of history with modern life. Old Delhi is for food and bazaars, New Delhi for monuments and museums.

places.name: Red Fort
places.desc: The 17th-century Mughal fort and a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

places.name: India Gate
places.desc: A war memorial arch, lovely in the evening when it is lit up.

places.name: Qutb Minar
places.desc: A towering medieval minaret surrounded by ancient ruins.

places.name: Humayun's Tomb
places.desc: A garden tomb that inspired later Mughal architecture, including the Taj Mahal.

places.name: Lotus Temple
places.desc: A flower-shaped Bahai house of worship, open to visitors of all faiths.

restaurants.name: Karim's
restaurants.known_for: Old Delhi classic for kebabs and curries.

restaurants.name: Paranthe Wali Gali
restaurants.known_for: A lane of shops famous for stuffed parathas.

restaurants.name: Bukhara
restaurants.known_for: Fine dining known for its rich dal and tandoori dishes.

name: Mumbai
tagline: The city that never sleeps: sea, cinema and street food
description: Mumbai is India's financial capital, with colonial architecture, a long seafront and a famous food scene.

places.name: Gateway of India
places.desc: The waterfront arch monument and a starting point for harbour boat rides.

places.name: Marine Drive
places.desc: A curved seaside promenade, perfect for sunset walks.

places.name: Elephanta Caves
places.desc: Ancient rock-cut cave temples reached by a ferry from the Gateway of India.

places.name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus
places.desc: A Victorian Gothic railway station and UNESCO World Heritage Site.

places.name: Haji Ali Dargah
places.desc: A mosque and tomb on an islet, reached by a causeway at low tide.

restaurants.name: Britannia & Co.
restaurants.known_for: Well known for its berry pulao and Parsi dishes.

restaurants.name: Sardar Pav Bhaji
restaurants.known_for: A long-time favourite for buttery pav bhaji.

restaurants.name: Kyani & Co.
restaurants.known_for: A classic Irani cafe for chai and bun maska.

name: Jaipur
tagline: The Pink City of forts, palaces and bazaars
description: Jaipur is the gateway to Rajasthan, with hilltop forts, royal palaces and colourful markets selling textiles and jewellery.

places.name: Amber Fort
places.desc: A hilltop fort-palace with mirror halls and stunning views.

places.name: Hawa Mahal
places.desc: The 'Palace of Winds' with its honeycomb facade of small windows.

places.name: City Palace
places.desc: A palace complex with museums, courtyards and royal collections.

places.name: Jantar Mantar
places.desc: An 18th-century astronomical observatory and UNESCO World Heritage Site.

places.name: Nahargarh Fort
places.desc: A fort with sweeping views of the city, especially good at sunset.

restaurants.name: Laxmi Misthan Bhandar (LMB)
restaurants.known_for: Traditional sweets and vegetarian Rajasthani meals.

restaurants.name: Rawat Mishthan Bhandar
restaurants.known_for: Famous for pyaaz kachori.

restaurants.name: Chokhi Dhani
restaurants.known_for: Village-themed dinner with folk performances.

name: Goa
description: Goa offers lively beaches in the north, quieter shores in the south, and old churches and forts with a distinct Indo-Portuguese culture.

places.name: Fort Aguada
places.desc: A 17th-century Portuguese fort and lighthouse overlooking the sea.

places.name: Basilica of Bom Jesus
places.desc: A UNESCO World Heritage church holding the relics of St. Francis Xavier.

places.name: Dudhsagar Falls
places.desc: A tall four-tiered waterfall, best seen just after the monsoon.

places.name: Anjuna
places.desc: A beach village known for its flea market and cafes.

places.name: Palolem
places.desc: A calm crescent beach with a relaxed atmosphere.

restaurants.name: Britto's
restaurants.known_for: A beachside favourite for Goan seafood.

restaurants.name: Vinayak Family Restaurant
restaurants.known_for: Home-style Goan seafood dishes.

restaurants.name: Fisherman's Wharf
restaurants.known_for: Riverside dining with Goan flavours.

name: Varanasi
tagline: One of the world's oldest living cities on the Ganga
description: Varanasi is a major spiritual centre, famous for its ghats, evening aarti, narrow lanes and street food.

places.name: Dashashwamedh Ghat
places.desc: The main ghat, known for the grand evening Ganga Aarti.

places.name: Kashi Vishwanath Temple
places.desc: One of the most famous Shiva temples in India.

places.name: Sarnath
places.desc: The place where the Buddha gave his first sermon, with stupas and a museum.

places.name: Assi Ghat
places.desc: A lively ghat, popular for sunrise and cultural events.

places.name: Ramnagar Fort
places.desc: An 18th-century fort and museum on the eastern bank.

restaurants.name: Blue Lassi Shop
restaurants.known_for: Thick lassi served in clay cups with fruit toppings.

restaurants.name: Kashi Chaat Bhandar
restaurants.known_for: Local chaat, including tamatar chaat.

restaurants.name: Kachori Gali stalls
restaurants.known_for: Morning kachori-sabzi with jalebi.

name: Manali
tagline: Himalayan valleys, snow and adventure sports
description: Manali sits in the Kullu Valley and is popular for snow, trekking, paragliding and mountain cafes.
best_time: March to June, and December to February for snow

places.name: Solang Valley
places.desc: A valley for skiing in winter and paragliding in summer.

places.name: Rohtang Pass
places.desc: A high pass with snow views. A permit is required and access depends on the season.

places.name: Hadimba Temple
places.desc: A wooden temple set in a cedar forest.

places.name: Beas River
places.desc: The river running through the valley, good for scenic walks and river activities.

restaurants.name: Johnson's Cafe
restaurants.known_for: A cozy cafe known for trout dishes.

restaurants.name: Cafe 1947
restaurants.known_for: Riverside cafe popular with travellers.

restaurants.name: Chopsticks
restaurants.known_for: Tibetan dishes such as thukpa and momos.

name: Bali
tagline: Temples, rice terraces, surf and wellness
description: Bali combines spiritual culture, green rice terraces, beaches and a strong wellness and cafe scene.

places.name: Uluwatu Temple
places.desc: A sea temple on a cliff, famous for sunsets and Kecak fire dance.

places.name: Tanah Lot
places.desc: A temple on a rock formation just off the coast.

places.name: Sacred Monkey Forest
places.desc: A forest sanctuary with temples and long-tailed macaques.

places.name: Tegallalang Rice Terrace
places.desc: Layered green rice terraces, best visited in the morning.

places.name: Mount Batur
places.desc: An active volcano popular for sunrise treks.

restaurants.name: Warung Ibu Oka
restaurants.known_for: Famous for babi guling (Balinese roast pork).

restaurants.name: Naughty Nuri's
restaurants.known_for: Known for grilled ribs and martinis.

restaurants.name: Bebek Bengil
restaurants.known_for: Known for crispy duck dishes.

name: Paris
description: Paris is known for its museums, riverside walks, historic districts and cafe culture.
best_time: April to June, September to October

places.name: Eiffel Tower
places.desc: The iconic iron tower with viewing platforms over the city.

places.name: Louvre Museum
places.desc: The world's largest art museum, home to the Mona Lisa.

places.name: Notre-Dame de Paris
places.desc: The Gothic cathedral on the Seine, restored after the 2019 fire.

places.name: Sacre-Coeur
places.desc: A white basilica on a hilltop with panoramic views.

places.name: Musee d'Orsay
places.desc: Impressionist art inside a former railway station.

restaurants.name: Cafe de Flore
restaurants.known_for: A historic cafe for coffee and pastries.

restaurants.name: L'As du Fallafel
restaurants.known_for: Popular falafel sandwiches.

restaurants.name: Angelina
restaurants.known_for: Famous for rich hot chocolate.

name: Tokyo
description: Tokyo combines neon districts, quiet shrines, gardens and some of the world's best food.
best_time: March to May, October to November

places.name: Senso-ji Temple
places.desc: Tokyo's oldest temple, with the Kaminarimon gate and Nakamise shopping street.

places.name: Meiji Shrine
places.desc: A peaceful Shinto shrine inside a forest in the middle of the city.

places.name: Shibuya Crossing
places.desc: One of the busiest pedestrian crossings in the world.

places.name: Tokyo Skytree
places.desc: A very tall broadcasting tower with observation decks.

places.name: Shinjuku Gyoen
places.desc: A large garden, beautiful in cherry blossom and autumn seasons.

restaurants.name: Ichiran
restaurants.known_for: Tonkotsu ramen served in individual booths.

restaurants.name: Sushi Dai
restaurants.known_for: Popular for fresh sushi, often with long queues.

restaurants.name: Tsunahachi
restaurants.known_for: A well-known tempura restaurant.
